page_title: GEN 0-1 LAZ | Genoa v Lazio 19/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) commits a foul and Ermano Feliciani immediately signals a free kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Morten Frendrup makes way for Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
87' A yellow card for bad language! Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
87' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) gets a yellow card, off the field.
86' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) replaces Luis Alberto.
82' Pedro (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Vogliacco departs the field of play to be replaced by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
79' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
78' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Genoa.
76' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luis Alberto (Lazio).
75' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

75' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Christos Mandas!
71' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:8.
68' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with David Ankeye (Genoa) replacing Caleb Ekuban.
68' That will be all from Kevin Strootman who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Milan Badelj (Genoa).
68' Here is a change. Felipe Anderson is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Pedro (Lazio).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) replaces Taty Castellanos.
67' 0 - 1 Luis Alberto (Lazio) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low shot that goes into the middle of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
66' Luis Alberto (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
66' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Luis Alberto (Lazio) will take the corner.
65' Patric (Lazio) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
62' The corner kick from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
61' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
61' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
59' Adam Marusic (Lazio) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' Luis Alberto (Lazio) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Mario Gila (Lazio) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
54' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

53' Luis Alberto (Lazio) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
49' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Igor Tudor has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) comes on the pitch for Nicolo Casale.
46' Referee Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Djed Spence (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
38' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Mateo Retegui (Genoa). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
36' Igor Tudor is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) suffers an injury and Elseid Hysaj comes on.
35' Looks like Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

34' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Christos Mandas pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
33' Luis Alberto (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

33' Luis Alberto (Lazio) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
29' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:3.
24' Mario Gila (Lazio) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
24' Lazio quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
23' A cross into the box from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
19' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is caught offside!
16' The game has begun to heat up. Nicolo Casale (Lazio) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
13' That was close by Mateo Retegui (Genoa)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
11' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Nicolo Casale (Lazio) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
8' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes it short.
7' Luis Alberto (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lazio will take a corner kick.
5' The opposition can't get near Caleb Ekuban (Genoa), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
3' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani is the one to supervise the game today.
